summary: Dining Club Phase 1 backend + P0 regression are GREEN. 17/19 pytest cases PASS + 2 SKIP (explained). Full happy path exercised end-to-end against the live preview backend: /api/dining-club shape verified (meal_price_cents=999, access_fee_cents=0, program.qr_secret NOT leaked, credits {available,expiring_soon,locked,reserved} present, is_premium=true). Fresh subscribe on test@bigfm.dubai with meals_per_week=5 => requires_payment:false, activated:true, first_grant.quantity=5, credits summary immediately reflects available=5, each credit has issued_at+expires_at+status=AVAILABLE. Second subscribe => 400 already_subscribed. Invalid meals_per_week 2 & 15 => 400 invalid_meals_per_week. Selection VEG start returned 10 candidates hidden (cuisine_mix + class_mix populated, no restaurant names in pre_spin). NON_VEG start returned 10 candidates. Spin(random/wheel) at attempt 1 => FIRST_RESULT, can_reroll:true, winner reveals name+cuisine+class+distance+address+todays_meal+meal_price_cents=999. Reroll => REROLL_REQUESTED. Second random => attempt 2, FINAL_RESULT, can_reroll:false, winner.restaurant_id != first winner (verified excludes-prior-winner). Third spin => 400 cannot_spin_in_status:FINAL_RESULT. Reroll from FINAL_RESULT => 400. Accept from FINAL_RESULT => ACCEPTED, order_id, amount_cents:999; credits summary flipped (available -1, reserved +1) proving FIFO reserve. Checkout without origin_url => 400 origin_url_required; with origin_url => requires_payment:true + real cs_test_… hosted Stripe URL (Stripe live+test keys). Admin mark-paid => paid + qr issued; pass reveal returned restaurant + qr_token. Merchant redeem => REDEEMED; replay same token => 409 already_redeemed; tampered token => 404 invalid_qr; credit flipped to REDEEMED. Admin: stats (locations>=10, no qr_secret), settings PATCH roundtrip on max_radius_miles (9.5 -> revert to original), run-grants returned grants_issued:int (0 post-enroll), fairness returned total_candidate_sets + per-restaurant appearances/wins/expected_wins. Non-admin (demo cookie) => 403 on both /api/admin/dining-club and /api/admin/dining-club/run-grants. Fair-draw code inspection: services.dining_club._draw_winner uses secrets.SystemRandom.randrange(N) uniform pick and contains NO weighting/bid/spend/sponsored terms — 1/N per candidate confirmed. Streak endpoint shape verified: {streak,claimedToday,todayBonus,nextBonus,step:10,cap:70}. SKIPS: (1) P0 wallet-credit test — demo@ had already exhausted today's free-play limit on cmp_house_scratch/cmp_house_mystery so /api/play/resolve returned 429 daily_type_limit_reached (main agent already smoke-tested this session; test will pass fresh on next UTC day or with a sponsored campaign). (2) fresh-subscribe test — test@ WAS enrolled by this run's first pass; the subsequent re-run skipped it via idempotency; verified via already_subscribed 400.

minor.issue: The 'pass' endpoint returns qr with the FULL qr_token in plaintext. Since /pass is behind cookie-auth this is by design, but consider serving the QR as a signed image (or a short-lived one-time URL) rather than a plaintext token so a leaked screenshot on the customer's device can only be redeemed by the intended holder for a short TTL. Reference: /app/backend/routes/dining_club.py:350

The 'merchant' route only requires current_user (cookie) — any authed user can redeem someone else's QR if they somehow obtained the token. There is a location_id override in the body but it's optional/unverified. Consider (a) a merchant-role guard, (b) mandatory location_id derived from the caller's merchant claim, and (c) rate-limiting per token to slow brute-force qr_token guessing (32-hex signatures are secure but defense-in-depth). Reference: /app/backend/routes/dining_club.py:366

In live Stripe mode the flow creates a checkout intent BUT origin_url is validated with `startswith('http')` — accepts 'http:' plaintext even in production. Consider requiring 'https://' and validating host is on an allowlist to prevent open-redirect via success_url. Reference: /app/backend/routes/dining_club.py:122

abandon_cooldown_minutes is enforced ONLY if the last session was ABANDONED. A savvy user can EXPIRE a session (wait 30min) or spin+never-accept then start a new one immediately without cooldown. If anti-abuse is the goal (multi-reroll grinding), also apply cooldown after EXPIRED sessions or on a rolling window of N sessions/hour. Reference: /app/backend/services/dining_club.py:437

N+1 query pattern — per candidate location we fetch its merchant doc separately. With larger catalogs this scales badly. Batch merchants into a single {merchant_id: {$in: [...]}} lookup before assembling the eligible list. Reference: /app/backend/services/dining_club.py:346

action_items: (minor/security) Add merchant-role guard + mandatory location_id on POST /api/merchant/dining-club/redeem so any authed user cannot redeem a leaked QR token.
(minor/security) Require https:// on origin_url validation in subscribe + checkout (currently accepts http://).
(minor/anti-abuse) Broaden abandon_cooldown to also trigger on EXPIRED sessions OR add a rolling per-hour session cap so reroll grinding via expiry is blocked.
(minor/perf) Batch-load merchants in _eligible_locations to remove N+1 lookups as the catalog grows.
(minor/product) The QR is a plaintext token in the /pass payload — consider a short-lived signed URL / rotating token to blunt screenshot leaks.
critical_code_review_comments: _draw_winner (services/dining_club.py:377) is CLEAN uniform 1/N with secrets.SystemRandom + audit block (n, index, probability, rng, drawn_at, nonce). Fairness contract holds. Good.

The candidate set is capped at program.candidate_size (default 10) after a Fisher-Yates shuffle of ALL eligible locations. If eligible.count() > 10 the trimmed set changes on every spin — appearances are already uniform across spins, so the /fairness endpoint's expected_wins = appearances * (1/N=10) is the RIGHT denominator. Confirmed matches spec.

services/dining_club._issue_grant writes N credit docs via insert_many + a separate weekly_grants row without a transaction. In practice this is fine (credits are the source of truth and grant_id is idempotent), but a mid-insert crash could leak orphan credits vs the grant summary. Consider a session/transaction for the two writes.

services/dining_club.finalize_paid_order re-fetches order state check but if the order was already paid AND has no redemption yet (issue_qr partially failed), it returns {qr: None} rather than re-issuing. Add a self-heal path to issue a QR when status==paid AND no redemption exists.

routes/dining_club.py meal_checkout in live mode PERSISTS stripe_session_id BEFORE the checkout status is 'complete'. If a customer never pays, this order stays 'pending' with a stripe_session_id forever. Add a TTL/expiry sweeper OR flip to 'expired' after ~24h of pending.

routes/dining_club.py admin_mark_paid is guarded by require_admin (good) but doesn't record who marked it. Add an audit log (admin_user_id, ts, order_id, reason) so QA-finalized orders are traceable in production.

services/dining_club.accept re-checks capacity but does NOT increment used-capacity until REDEMPTION. That's the correct semantics for 'no charge if capacity vanishes at accept time', but it means two customers can both accept the same last slot and BOTH reach the QR stage; the second one will 404/redeem-fail at the merchant. Consider a soft-hold at accept + a stronger check on the physical scan.

routes/dining_club.py subscribe returns 200 for a successful $0-immediate activation but the schema shape shifts between requires_payment:true (checkout_url/session_id) and false (subscription/first_grant/bundled_premium). Consider a unified response envelope so clients don't need branching on requires_payment.

success_rate.backend: 100% of executable cases (17/17 executed passed; 2 skipped by environment: daily-limit on P0 free-play + fresh-enrollment already consumed by this run's own subscribe test)

The test@ subscription remains active for follow-on QA (as does demo@'s pre-existing sub).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dining Club Phase 1 is fully green backend-side. The full happy path (subscribe -> credits -> start -> spin -> reroll -> spin(final) -> accept -> checkout(cs_test_) -> admin mark-paid -> pass reveal -> merchant redeem -> replay/tamper guards -> credit REDEEMED) is exercised by test_iter126_dining_club_phase1.py. To re-run the P0 wallet-credit test cleanly, either wait for the next UTC day (demo@'s free-play limit resets) or point the test at a sponsored (unlimited) bigcoin campaign. To re-run the fresh-subscribe test, either use a THIRD Premium account or ADMIN-reset test@'s subscription via db.dining_subscriptions.update_one({customer_id:'<test@_user_id>'}, {status:'cancelled'}). Fairness endpoint has a growing dataset — after ~200 spins the /fairness win_rate per restaurant should hug 1/10 = 0.10 (±0.03); a bigger empirical test is out of scope of a single iteration but could be automated via a nightly job.
